serialization.index_semantics: primitive_index is the zero-based full-grid row ordinal; decision_index is the output-coordinate t; fill_index=decision_index+1; end_index=decision_index+4 is the inclusive final return bar; scheduled decision indices advance by four
serialization.field_order: record_fields exactly as listed; no sorting or omission
serialization.row_order: original chronological primitive_index order; full scheduled grid rows, including false-mask gap rows
serialization.shape: each field is a one-dimensional array of shape (record_count,), encoded in C order
serialization.value_encoding: little-endian IEEE-754 float64 (=<f8); finite values preserve bits and every NaN uses 0x7ff8000000000000; infinities are rejected
serialization.bool_encoding: strict bool values encoded one byte each as 0x00 or 0x01
serialization.string_encoding: UTF-8 bytes with a little-endian uint64 byte-length prefix per value
serialization.field_framing: field name and ASCII dtype tag are uint64-length-prefixed; ndim=1 and the one-element shape use little-endian uint64; data byte length is uint64-prefixed before field bytes
serialization.content_framing: magic UNIDREAM-P1-ACTION-PRIMITIVE-CONTENT\x00 followed by uint64 record_count and fields in record_fields order
serialization.payload_framing: magic UNIDREAM-P1-ACTION-PRIMITIVE-PAYLOAD\x00 followed by length-prefixed canonical UTF-8 JSON header and length-prefixed canonical content bytes
serialization.json_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=false

hash_scopes.action_primitive_schema_sha256: SHA-256 of this external schema JSON canonical UTF-8 bytes; the schema digest is pinned outside any action payload and is not self-declared by a record
hash_scopes.action_primitive_content_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical content bytes for every record_fields field and every original full-grid row in row order; hash fields themselves are excluded
hash_scopes.action_primitive_payload_sha256: SHA-256 of the framed payload magic, canonical JSON header containing record_count/record_fields/schema_sha256/content_sha256, and the canonical content bytes; no payload hash field is included
hash_scopes.hash_field_exclusion: payload/schema/content hash declarations are not included as record fields and cannot self-bind their own value
hash_scopes.external_schema_authority: docs/experiments/action_primitive_schema.json with an independently pinned canonical SHA-256 in the P1 manifest

grid_policy.schedule: split-local starts 0,4,... from canonical complete_decision_starts; one record per scheduled structurally complete non-overlapping h4 block
grid_policy.gap_rows: retain every scheduled primitive row in its original position; false masks mark forecast/outcome gaps and no physical row compression is permitted
grid_policy.common_mask: strict bool intersection mask for paired comparison eligibility; it is persisted and hashed even when false
grid_policy.state: positions and inventory are fixed from one chronological replay; bootstrap never replays state across sampled records
grid_policy.unimplemented_status: producer and moving-block bootstrap remain blocked on this preregistration branch; generic MBB is forbidden
